entities.summary: Marc David Polmans is a South African-born Australian professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 116 achieved on 12 October 2020 and a best doubles ranking of world No. 58 achieved on 30 March 2026. His best achievement is reaching the 2026 Australian Open doubles final, with compatriot Jason Kubler.
